plan.purpose: compare FNO against simple nominal secant at the same observable residual reduction; development only
plan.accept: strict physical squared receiver residual decrease
plan.stop: relative receiver residual <= initial relative residual * .001; threshold is prospective for this new development batch, not a final-test acceptance threshold
plan.timing: synchronize CUDA at boundaries; include initial solve, all accepted/rejected proposals, input encoding and response generation; separately charge model load, observations and historical offline cost; distinguish per-case direction and shared direction reuse
report: final parameter error only after stopping
reached tolerance or censored at cap
actual online wall time and calls
no amortization count unless incremental offline cost and positive matched-quality savings both known
plan.scope: known support and reused depths; not blind inversion, not full traditional adjoint FWI comparison

execution: one timed route per method/case, alternate method order; no extra warmup; timings descriptive; global physical cap 56 includes observations, so cap may censor last routes; 240 second compute cap
truth_policy: target a only observation generation and final reporting; solve() receives obs and mask, no target a
direction_policy: each FNO case two new network calls on gamma only; no physical labels to generate direction; nominal slope from historical two anchors; shared direction reuse estimated separately
